curationNote: Six-video bilingual test set. Every item requires human review; inclusion does not imply endorsement of every claim in the video.

collections.title: Vayetzei
collections.summary: Three French and three English companions, preserving all six recurring approved channels. Toldot has no collection on main, so comparison uses the latest available set. One current Kaplan upload; five explicitly archival selections to recheck Friday. IDs, titles, channels and oEmbed verified 2026-11-16. Languages supported by captions for the first four and publisher metadata for the last two; human listening review remains required.

videos.title: La Paracha Vayetse avec le Rav Oury Cherki.
videos.relation: Exil, échelle et rencontre au puits : vue d'ensemble de la série récurrente du Rav Oury Cherki. Archive choisie pour sa pertinence exacte, aucun épisode actuel identifié lors de la recherche.

videos.title: Résumé de la PARACHA VAYÉTSÉ - L'échelle de Yaakov, Mariage avec Léa & Ra'hel, Lavan,...
videos.relation: Orientation narrative avant l'étude des cinq sugyot. Illustrations IA expressément signalées par l'éditeur comme approximatives; archive exacte retenue en attendant une publication actuelle plus pertinente.

videos.title: Apprécier l’ordinaire
videos.relation: L'éditeur identifie ce cours comme Parachat Vayetsé, 27 novembre 2020. Compagnon sur l'attention à l'ordinaire, mis en dialogue avec reconnaissance et gratitude; ce rapprochement est éditorial et ne vaut pas preuve classique.

videos.title: Hashem the Matchmaker – Parashat Vayeitzei (Rabbi Dovid Kaplan)
videos.relation: This week's Rabbi Dovid Kaplan upload accompanies the chapter's marriage and providence questions; the relationship is an editorial entry point, not evidence for a source claim.

videos.title: Covenant & Conversation | Vayetse | Rabbi Sacks
videos.relation: The publisher links this episode to The Character of Jacob; retain the recurring philosophical archive for comparison with the chapter's integrity and responsibility themes.

videos.title: Parsha Vayetze, an In Depth Analysis with Kabbalistic Insights
videos.relation: Long-form later interpretation from the recurring approved channel; no exact current Vayetzei upload was identified. Recheck Friday and keep this interpretive layer distinct from peshat and classical-source verification.

collections.title: Vayishlach
collections.summary: Three French and three English companions. Four channels recur from Vayetzei (Torah-Box, Ohr Somayach, Rabbi Sacks and Rabbi Shusterman); exact French SHOFAR and HEVRATPINTO videos were not verified, so the two alternatives explain their inclusion. IDs, titles, channels and YouTube oEmbed checked November 23, 2026. Language labels use publisher context; human listening remains pending. No current Kaplan upload was verified; keep the exact-portion archive and recheck Friday.

videos.title: Résumé de la PARACHA VAYICHLA'H - Yaakov VS Essav, Dina et Shékhem, Beth El, Mort d'Its'hak,...

videos.relation: Repères pour situer la rencontre avec Ésaü, Dina et le retour à Béthel. Les images ne sont pas des sources; la section sur Dina mérite un accompagnement adapté.

videos.title: Vayichla'h : Israël, la force fragile

videos.title: Le pont très étroit de la vie... Parachat Vayichla'h  selon Rabbi Nahman -  Rav Chlomo Valensi
